findings.highlight: I feel a little excited as I run into the yard.
findings.evidenceJa: かすかに興奮しながら庭に跳び退く。
findings.governingReading: 庭に跳び退く continues the specified backward leap used to escape the faster pursuer.
findings.explanation: Backward leap into yard becomes running.

findings.highlight: Her bloodlust is gone, and it doesn't seem like it'll ever return.
findings.evidenceJa: 殺気はもう届かず、戻ってくる予感もなかった。
findings.governingReading: 戻ってくる予感もなかった refers to Rider’s anticipated return after her presence recedes.
findings.explanation: No expectation Rider will return becomes bloodlust will never return.
